description:
**Job Title: Insurance Advisor**

**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time / Part\-time  
**Industry:** Life Insurance \& Financial Services

Job Description

We are looking for motivated and enthusiastic individuals to join our team as **Insurance Advisors**. The role involves helping customers understand their financial protection and investment needs and suggesting suitable insurance solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Generate and develop new customer leads through personal and professional networks.
* Understand customers' financial goals and insurance requirements.
* Explain life insurance, protection, savings and investment solutions.
* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with customers.
* Follow up with prospective customers and schedule appointments.
* Assist customers throughout the application and policy process.
* Achieve assigned business and customer\-service objectives.

Requirements

* Minimum qualification: 12th Pass / Graduate.
* Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Self\-motivated and interested in sales/financial services.
* Local candidates from Coimbatore are preferred.

What We Offer

* Attractive incentive\-based earning opportunity.
* Flexible working options.
* Training and product guidance.
* Career growth opportunities.
* Opportunity to build your own customer.

title: Team Leader - Operations
description:
Team Leader

**Location:** Madurai \& Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Experience:** Minimum 5 years  
**Salary:** ₹20,000 – ₹25,000 per month \+ Incentives  
**Job Type:** Full\-time

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Team Leader** to lead and manage a team of Agri Doctors / Field Officers and drive business growth in the assigned district.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead, guide, and motivate the field team.
* Plan and monitor daily field activities, farmer visits, demonstrations, and crop inspections.
* Build strong relationships with farmers, dealers, and distributors.
* Identify farmer needs and provide suitable agricultural solutions.
* Drive sales, product adoption, collections, and achievement of monthly targets.
* Monitor crop, pest, disease, and market activities.
* Train and support team members in field and technical activities.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports and share market feedback with management.

Requirements

* Minimum **5 years of experience in Fertilizers / Agri\-inputs OR FMCG**.
* Experience in **team handling, field sales, and business development**.
* Good communication and leadership skills.
* Strong customer/farmer relationship management skills.
* Willingness to travel within the assigned district.
* Agriculture background will be an added advantage.

**Preferred Locations:** Candidates from or willing to work in **Madurai or Coimbatore**.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

License/Certification:

* 2 Wheeler Licence (Preferred)

Location:

* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu (Preferred)

Willingness to travel:

* 100% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
